page.layout: Running head at top left: page number "82". Running title at top centre. Below it, two round portrait medallions with circular legends (left: Romulus, right: Hersilia), set side by side. Below them one column of running text, then one paragraph on Hersilia, then an italic verse passage. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: ROMVLVS Romanorum Rex primus, imperauit anno mundi 3212. ante Christum natum 750. filius fuit Rheæ Iliæ Vestalis,quem vnà cum Remo,vnico partu edidit, qui paruuli prope ripam Tyberis expositi, tamen à Faustulo ad Accâ Laurentiam delati sunt: vbi adoleuerunt,collecta pastorum manu, Amulium interfecerunt,& Numitorem auum in regnum resti tuerunt, qui pulsus fuerat à fratre suo Amulio minore natu. Poftea vrbê ædificant vbi fuerant expositi, quæ Roma dicta est à conditoris nomine Romulo:qui Remũ fratrem occidit,quòd ludibrio & quasi per contemptum Romuli, nouos transiluisset muros : cẽtum senatores creat Romulus, qui Patres ab honore, Patricij eorũ progenies appellati.300. armatos ad custodiâ corporis,quos Celeres appellauit,non in bello solùm,sed etiam in pace habuit.ex Sabinis & Rom.vnicam gentem fecit.post subactos Ceninenses, Antemnates, Crustuminos, Fidenates, Veientes, cum ad recensendum exercitum concionem in campo haberet,subitò orta tempestate,cum fragore & tonitribus,tam denso opertus est nimbo , vt conspectum eius concioni abstulerit tempestas , nec deinde in terris sit visus. imperauit annos 37.Vide Tit.Liu.li.1.Diony.Halicar.lib.2. & Eutro.lib.1.
HERSILIA, vxor fuit Romuli,de qua Ti.Li.1.deca.1.De hac nonnihil fabulatur etiam Ouidius,ad calcem 14.lib.Metamorph. inquiens:

p.i: Flebat vt amissum coniux, cùm regia Iuno Irin ad Herfiliam descendere limite curuo Imperat : & vacuæ sua sic mandata referre: O & de Latio, ò & de gente Sabina Præcipuum matrona d[?]cus, d[?]gnifsima tanti Ante fuiffe viri coniux,nunc eff. Quirini, Siste tuos fletus. &c.

page.notes: Two round portrait medallions (engravings) with circular legends; the legends are transcribed above as printed: left "ROMVLVS" (read around the medallion, with "R O" at lower left), right "HERSILIA." and "SABIN" (end of legend possibly cut off by the engraving edge). The verse line "Irin ad Herfiliam" is printed as such. In line 5, the word "decus" and "dignissima" have missing ink; the letter is marked [?]. "coniux" in line 6 has a gap after "co", read as coniux. Printed spacing of "3212" and "750" in the text is irregular, copied as the number. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Vide Tit.Liu.li.1" and "Herfiliam" in the quotation.
